elements.name: Open and close the Sketch Constrain panel expansion

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open with an active editable `Sketch1` in the MCAD Software
the Sketch ribbon is expanded and the Constrain panel is visible
the Constrain panel's additional command area is closed
the user opens the Constrain panel expansion
an additional command area opens below the panel over the workspace
Edit Coordinate System and Constraint Inference Scope are visible
the sketch and model browser remain visible
the Constrain additional command area remains open
the user clicks empty viewport space
the Constrain additional command area closes
the editable sketch remains active and unchanged
